text_block_list.text:
While out for a walk at dusk,
I came across Fuji Kiseki working up a sweat all on her own...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
choice_data_list: Maybe I ate too much... or something?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Um... Lately, I've been busy with dorm duties,
so my meal times have been irregular...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And then... I stepped on the scale... ahaha.
choice_data_list: You should have just talked to me about it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...I really didn't want my fans
to see me struggling like this—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I kept quiet so that no one would find out...
I'm sorry."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So this diet is a secret just between
Trainer and me... deal?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right, five more sets of running up
and down the stairs... Let's do it together!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As fellow secret-sharers,
let's get along, shall we?♪

Working through the routine together,
Fuji Kiseki's diet ended in complete success...!
